title: Crypto Prop Firm Registry and Verified Payouts — Roya Trading (snapshot 2026-11-01)
description:
Dated, machine-readable registry of crypto / on-chain proprietary trading firms maintained by Roya Trading: 11 scored firms ranked on a public six-criterion Trust Score grid (last reviewed 2026-10-29; sub-scores published so every total can be recomputed), 8 entities tracked without a score, 14 DNS/HTTP status records (last verified 2026-11-01), an append-only changelog, and a headline counter (1 of 14 tracked firms gone dark since 2026-06, as of 2026-11-01).

Companion file: 104 prop-firm payouts received on Roya Trading's own accounts from 4 firms, 26,941.72 USDC received on-chain in 102 transfers reconciled on a public blockchain to the cent (81 Propr.xyz on Ethereum, 11 Hypernova, 1 Vest Markets and 9 MyFundedPerps withdrawals settling 11 payouts on Arbitrum; read 2026-11-01), each transfer with its transaction hash.

Every figure carries its read date. The files are regenerated at every deploy of roya-trading.com; this record is a dated snapshot and the live endpoints win when they differ. Detection rules: https://roya-trading.com/prop-firm-graveyard/methodology/ — Scoring grid: https://roya-trading.com/trust-score/ — Affiliate disclosure: https://roya-trading.com/about/
notes: Snapshot generated 2026-11-01 (registry format v1.5; see data/READ_AT.txt). No affiliate links, no private wallet addresses: firm identifiers are the firms' own published contract/payout addresses. Some listed firms pay Roya Trading an affiliate commission on sign-ups through its site links (disclosure: https://roya-trading.com/about/); scores and statuses are not for sale.
